'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Catatumbo campaign]]
***[[2025 Catatumbo clashes]]
****The [[Colombia]]n [[National Army of Colombia|National Army]] and [[National Police of Colombia|National Police]] begin [[Offensive (military)|offensive]] operations across eleven [[Municipio|''municipios'']] of the [[Catatumbo region]]. [https://www.eltiempo.com/justicia/conflicto-y-narcotrafico/arrancan-las-operaciones-ofensivas-en-catatumbo-mindefensa-y-cupula-de-la-fuerza-publica-pasan-revista-3420649 (''El Tiempo'')]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
***[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
****At least thirteen [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|Islamic State]] militants are allegedly killed in heavy fighting as [[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland forces]] claim they successfully took over the towns of Turmasaale and Janno-Jiifta in the [[Bari, Somalia|Bari region]], [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]]. [https://thesomalidigest.com/puntland-troops-seize-strategic-mountain-village-deal-blow-to-isis/ (''The Somali Digest'')] [https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-forces-seize-key-towns-from-isis-gain-strategic-advantage-in-bari-region/ (Idil News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] targets an [[oil refinery]] in [[Ryazan Oblast]], [[Russia]], in one of the largest [[Ukrainia]]n drone attacks inside Russia of the conflict to date. The [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] says it shot down at least 121 drones over 13 regions overnight. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg84r5g8d0o (BBC News)]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***A Russian drone strikes a ten-storey [[apartment building]] in [[Fastiv]], [[Kyiv Oblast]], Ukraine, killing at least three people. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/01/24/at-least-three-killed-in-overnight-russian-drone-attack-on-kyiv (Euronews)]
**[[Mobilization in Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] finalizes military reforms aimed at recruiting 18- to 25-year-olds to the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|armed forces]], penalizing [[Draft evasion|draft dodgers]], and lowering the minimum [[conscription|compulsory military service]] age to 25 from 27. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-finalizes-draft-reform-to-attract-18-to-25-year-olds-media-reports/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**The Ukrainian [[Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War]] announces that, with assistance from the [[International Committee of the Red Cross]], the bodies of 757 Ukrainian soldiers have been returned to Ukraine. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-repatriates-757-bodies/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Hamas]] confirms that an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] airstrike last summer killed [[Rawhi Mushtaha]], who according to Israel was the "head of the [[Gaza Strip under Hamas|Hamas government]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]", along with Sameh al-Siraj, who held the security portfolio in Hamas's [[List of leaders of Hamas|political bureau]], and Sami Odeh, the head of Hamas's "general security mechanism". [https://aawsat.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A/5104053-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%BA-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%84%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D9%85%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84%D9%87%D9%85-%D9%81%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%87%D9%85%D8%9F (''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[97th Academy Awards]]
**''[[I'm Still Here (2024 film)|I'm Still Here]]'' becomes the first [[Cinema of Brazil|Brazilian]] film to be nominated for [[Academy Award for Best Picture|Best Picture]], while [[Karla Sofía Gascón]] becomes the first openly transgender actress to be nominated for [[Academy Award for Best Actress|Best Actress]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/entertainment/movies/2025/01/23/oscar-nominations-where-watch-stream/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/brazilians-jubilant-im-still-here-historic-oscar-nomination-best-picture-2025-01-23/ (Reuters)] [https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/spotlights/2025/emilia-perez-tops-oscar-nominations-with-13-wicked-and-the-brutalist-land-10-apiece/ (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Canadian economic crisis (2022–present)|Canadian economic crisis]]
**The [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada|Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship department]] announces a limit of 437,000 [[International students in Canada|study permits]] for 2025, a 10% reduction from 2024, as part of efforts to address [[Canadian property bubble|pressures on housing]], [[Healthcare in Canada|healthcare]], and other [[Public services in Canada|public services]] caused by the country's [[Population of Canada|rapid population growth]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canada-reduces-international-student-permits-second-year-2025-01-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] announces that it will invest {{USD}}600 billion in the [[United States]] economy. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/saudi-arabia/2025/01/24/saudi-economy-minister-says-600-bln-package-with-us-includes-investments-procurement (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Spirit Airlines]] announces a ban on passengers who wear "lewd" clothing or have "offensive" [[tattoo]]s. [https://thehill.com/policy/transportation/5105837-spirit-airlines-rules-clothing-tattoos/ (''The Hill'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 European windstorm season]]
**[[Storm Éowyn]]
***A [[wind gust]] provisionally measured at {{conv|183|km/h|abbr=on}} was recorded in [[Connemara]] in [[County Galway]], [[Ireland]], and a mean [[wind speed]] measured at {{conv|135|km/h|abbr=on}}, would surpass Ireland's previous records. [https://www.irishtimes.com/environment/2025/01/24/storm-eowyn-live-updates-status-red-warning-ireland-met-eireann-power-outages-transport/ (''The Irish Times'')]
***A man is killed in [[County Donegal]], Ireland, after high winds cause a tree to fall on his car. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c78x4503neyo (BBC News)]
*[[Environmental issues in Somalia]]
**At least 140 [[dolphins]] are found stranded on the shores of [[Mareero|Mareero Beach]] near [[Bosaso]], [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]], with 60 confirmed dead and 30 returned to the sea. [https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-mass-dolphin-stranding-prompts-environmental-investigation-in-bosaso-of-bari-region/ (Idil News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/more-than-100-dead-dolphins-found-somali-coast-cause-mystery-2025-01-24/ (Reuters)] [https://hornobserver.com/articles/3144/Over-100-dolphins-were-washed-ashore-in-Somalias-northeastern-region-of-Puntland (''Horn Observer'')]
*Nine people are killed in an explosion at an ordnance factory in [[Bhandara]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/eight-people-killed-ordnance-factory-explosion-western-india-2025-01-24/ (Reuters)]
